description: On the quiz, picking the right club marks it and opens the answer, answering all ten shows the score, and New questions deals ten fresh ones

steps.eval: (() => { const q = document.querySelector('.quiz-q'); q.querySelector(`button[data-era="${q.dataset.answer}"]`).click(); return q.querySelector('details').open && q.querySelector('.is-right') && !q.querySelector('.is-wrong'); })()
